The usual initial dose in adults and children 2 years of age and older is 20 mg/kg once daily, taken on an empty stomach at least 30 minutes before food. Serum fer- ritin should be monitored monthly and the dose should be adjust- ed every 3 to 6 months as necessary. The maximum recommend- ed dose is 30 mg/kg daily. ◊ References. 1. Adverse Effects and Precautions Deferiprone has been shown to cause neutropenia and should not be used in neutropenic patients; the neutrophil count should be monitored weekly and treatment should be stopped if neutrope- nia develops. Agranulocytosis has also occurred. Patients should be advised to seek immediate medical attention if symptoms in- dicative of infection such as fever, sore throat, or flu-like symp- toms occur.
